The Congress high command has asked him to move to the Rajya Sabha, paving the way for a leadership change. **Randeep Singh Surjewala**, the All India Congress Committee general secretary in charge of Karnataka, arrived in Bengaluru to facilitate the transition process. While some party members are pushing for his resignation, he has refused to comment on the matter and only stated that he will speak tomorrow.

recent_articles.title: India orders demolition drive along Pakistan border - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Amit Shah**, India's interior minister, ordered the demolition of illegal buildings within 15 kilometers of the Pakistan border.  He emphasized a zero-tolerance policy against such constructions and directed authorities to demolish all unauthorized structures. **Shah** also urged increased efforts to address infiltration, narcotics smuggling, encroachment, terror financing, and other trans-border crimes. This order was issued during a visit to Rajasthan, which borders Pakistan.

recent_articles.title: CPI(M), CPI: India's communists once ruled millions. What happened to them?
recent_articles.rephrased_article: India's communist parties, once dominant in several states, have lost their grip on power. The defeat of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)-led Left Democratic Front (LDF) in Kerala marks a significant shift, ending one of the world's longest-running experiments in democratic communism. While the party has seen its influence diminish across various regions, it remains politically relevant in Kerala and continues to hold onto some support in other states like Tamil Nadu. The decline is attributed to factors including economic stagnation, changing political landscapes, and a shift towards identity politics. Despite these challenges, the CPI (M) insists on adapting to the modern economy and seeks to revitalize its presence within the Indian political landscape.

recent_articles.title: Thrice rebuffed for US visa, Sanjay Mehrotra joins Satya Nadella and Sundar Pichai in the trillion-dollar club - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sanjay Mehrotra**, CEO of Micron Technology, achieved a remarkable rise from being denied a student visa in the 1970s to becoming one of America's most valuable technology company leaders.  His journey exemplifies an extraordinary trend: three of the world’s most valuable technology companies – Microsoft, Alphabet, and Micron – are now run by Indian-born executives who arrived in the US as middle-class strivers. This success story is reshaping Silicon Valley and the political debate over globalization in Donald Trump's MAGA-fied America.  Mehrotra's rise also highlights a shift in corporate America towards technocratic immigrant executives with deep managerial discipline, fueled by the AI era's demand for operational complexity and geopolitical balancing.

recent_articles.title: Hundreds flee India migrant crackdown towards Bangladesh - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hundreds** of people in India's border region with Bangladesh have fled to the frontier after the **Indian government** ordered the construction of detention centers for undocumented Bangladeshi migrants and Rohingya refugees.  **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, leading the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, has implemented a hardline policy to "detect, delete, and deport" illegal migrants, citing national security concerns. The decision has fueled anxiety among India's Muslim population, with some fearing increased marginalization. **Home Minister Amit Shah** announced the formation of a special committee on demographic change, emphasizing the threat posed by illegal migration to national security.

recent_articles.title: India seeks proposals for 5th generation combat jets: ANI - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** has invited proposals from three Indian companies to locally manufacture a fifth-generation combat aircraft. The shortlisted bidders are Tata Advanced Systems, joint ventures between **Larsen and Toubro-Bharat Electronics**, and Bharat Forge-BEML.  The program aims to bolster the **Indian Air Force**, which currently operates below its approved strength of 42 squadrons. This initiative aligns with Prime Minister **Narendra Modi’s** goal of boosting local manufacturing and enhancing India's military capabilities.
